entries.subject: PREFLIGHT and inventory contract conflict
entries.text: Existing add-single admits the security-gated DEVICE_CONFIRM capability and the dialog remains open while polling it. The requested separate PREFLIGHT auth job plus automatic INVENTORY_COLLECT requires a new capability, new device-contact semantics, and a new admission dependency; neither is supplied by this dispatch. Please provide the frozen contract or authorize an explicit minimal mapping before implementation.

entries.subject: PREFLIGHT logic
entries.text: You are correct. Do not create a new PREFLIGHT capability. Use the existing DEVICE_CONFIRM job as the auth-check. Update the UI dialog to poll for DEVICE_CONFIRM, and upon success, automatically request INVENTORY_COLLECT and continue polling. Implement the max-5 concurrency limit for INVENTORY_COLLECT.

changed: AddDeviceDialog now polls DEVICE_CONFIRM, submits inventory only after COMPLETED enrollment, and polls that returned job id.
The atomic claim SQL serializes claims and refuses additional inventory claims while five inventory jobs are CLAIMED or EXECUTING.
Updated the dialog test and atomic-claim SQL guard test.
